channel.title: Governance Digest
channel.description: New DAO governance proposals and discussions, summarized in plain English.

item.title: Request for a clear stUSDS withdrawal and liquidity plan (sky)
item.description: A forum post from an stUSDS holder asks Sky governance for a public plan to restore withdrawals, which the post says have been blocked for over a week.

item.title: 23 November, 2026 - Roundup of Active/Upcoming Votes (arbitrum)
item.description: Arbitrum's roundup lists an on-chain Constitutional AIP in which Binance asks the DAO to release frozen ETH and ARB; voting ends December 4.

item.title: Security Council Lead Self-Nomination: alisha.eth (optimism)
item.description: The current Optimism Security Council Lead nominates themselves to continue in the Lead role.

item.title: Atlas Edit Weekly Cycle Proposal - Week Of 2026-11-23 (sky)
item.description: Core GovOps submits this week's Atlas edits for Sky: NFAT pilot definitions, a Swap Asset Facet, higher Osero rate limits and housekeeping fixes. Discussion stage.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Borrow Cap Increases on Aave V3 / 2026.11.21 (aave)
item.description: A risk-service forum post recommends raising borrow caps for WETH, cbBTC and WBTC on Aave V3 Core.

item.title: stUSDS liquidation ratio (sky)
item.description: A forum post alleges Sky governance never restored the stUSDS liquidation ratio to 145% after lowering it to 120%.

item.title: [ARFC] - Enable LiquidityBufferController Sweeps via Circle Gateway on Aave V4 Ethereum Core Hub (aave)
item.description: A proposal would let Aave V4 move idle USDC from the Ethereum Core Hub into Circle Gateway to earn yield.

item.title: Coinbase Wrapped BTC (cbBTC) on Aave Tempo Assessments (aave)
item.description: Low-information post: a thread collecting risk assessments for cbBTC on Aave Tempo.

item.title: [Direct-To-AIP] Umbrella Reward Renewal and Parameter Update on Aave V3 Core (aave)
item.description: A direct-to-AIP proposal would extend Aave V3 Umbrella rewards to April 2, 2027 and raise stablecoin target liquidity.

item.title: GIP-[XXX]: Blockscout SLA and Hosting Renewal (January 2027 - December 2027) (gnosis)
item.description: A draft Gnosis funding proposal asks for $106,800 to renew Blockscout explorer hosting and SLA for 2027.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Cap Changes on Aave V4 / 2026.11.20 (aave)
item.description: A risk-service forum post recommends raising several supply and borrow caps on Aave V4 and lowering the LBTC cap.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Supply and Borrow Cap and IRM Changes on Aave V3 / 2026.11.20 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends raising Aave V3 Core caps (USDC borrow to 4B, USDe, sUSDe, WBTC), cutting many caps across other instances, and setting rsETH-family supply caps to 1.

item.title: Aave V3.8 for integrators: what the reentrancy guard covers and what it leaves open (aave)
item.description: A technical forum post reviews Aave V3.8's new reentrancy lock: most Pool actions are now guarded, but flash loan callbacks stay open, as in V3.7.

item.title: Immediate one-off SKY buyback (sky)
item.description: The Core Council announces a one-off buyback of SKY: 750k USDS a day for 7 days (5.25M USDS total), with the SKY burned.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Supply and Borrow Cap and IRM Changes on Aave V3 / 2026.11.19 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends raising several Aave V3 Core supply caps (USDC to 5B, WETH, wstETH, cbBTC, weETH) and cutting caps on Plasma, Mantle, Monad, Optimism, Polygon and Gnosis.

item.title: Temporary measures to stabilize Sky token price (sky)
item.description: A forum post proposes redirecting staking emissions toward SKY-SKY staking and temporarily cutting ABC Step 2 to 25% to increase buybacks.

item.title: Security Council: Lead Election (optimism)
item.description: Optimism opens the election for the Security Council Lead, a 24-month role that now also recruits and nominates the Council's key holders. Self-nominations close 25 November.

item.title: LEGO Grant Proposal: eth-dvt-signer (lido)
item.description: A one-person project asks for a $37,000 LEGO grant to build eth-dvt-signer, a threshold validator signer for on-prem AMD SEV-SNP hardware, in response to the Lido signer RFP.

item.title: [December 3, 2026] Proposed changes to Osero for upcoming Spell (sky)
item.description: Proposed changes for the Dec 3, 2026 spells would let Osero send USDS to and subscribe USDS in a Test NFAT Facility for the NFAT Pilot, and raise Osero's allocator vault debt ceiling from 100M to 500M USDS.

item.title: Zodiac Reality Module on the legacy Safe: Invalid or No? (gnosis)
item.description: A forum post says a question about a proposal that does not exist on Snapshot was submitted to the Reality module of GnosisDAO's legacy Safe, and argues the correct answer is No.

item.title: [ARFC] Expand Coinbase Tokenized Equities on Base (aave)
item.description: An ARFC proposes adding six Coinbase tokenized equities (Netflix, Oracle, Palantir, AMD, ServiceNow, Strategy) as collateral-only reserves on the Aave V4 Equities Hub on Base.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Cap and IRM Changes on Aave V4 / 2026.11.18 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends small Slope 1 rate increases on five Aave V4 stablecoin hub reserves and higher add caps for the NVDAc and METAc tokenized equities on the Base Equities Hub.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Cap and IRM Changes on Aave V3 / 2026.11.18 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends Aave V3 cap changes (WBTC supply cap up, USDT borrow cap up, USDC borrow cap down, two Horizon caps down) and a set of stablecoin interest-rate tweaks across several instances.

item.title: Deprecation Notice: eth_sendRawTransactionConditional (arbitrum)
item.description: Offchain Labs gives notice it intends to disable the eth_sendRawTransactionConditional RPC method on Arbitrum One and Nova by Jan 17, 2027, after a 30-day comment period and 30-day grace period.

item.title: RFP: open Ethereum validator signers for on-prem and isolated hardware (lido)
item.description: A Lido RFP invites proposals for open-source validator signers that keep keys inside hardware the operator controls, with grants expected well below $50k.

item.title: [November 23, 2026] Grove Governance Proposals: Grove Artifact Edit Proposal (sky)
item.description: Grove Labs proposes adding Steakhouse Financial's new SteakhouseOperator contract as an Allocator on seven Grove x Steakhouse Morpho vaults, to be decided in a Grove poll opening Nov 23.

item.title: [Gauntlet] Mantle USDe Comet: Closing Remaining Positions (compound)
item.description: Gauntlet and Woof recommend lowering liquidation collateral factors to 0.5% on the deprecated Mantle USDe Comet so the last 10 open borrow positions can be absorbed and the market wound down.

item.title: [Direct-to-AIP] Asset Listing - USDC Plasma (aave)
item.description: TokenLogic proposes listing Circle's native USDC on the Aave V3 Plasma instance, configured in line with USDT0, and adding it as a borrowable asset to eight eMode categories.

item.title: Safenet Aegis Rewards Distribution - Period 2 (safe)
item.description: A post reports that Safenet Aegis rewards for the Oct 27 - Nov 10, 2026 period were distributed on Nov 18 after the permissionless Reality.eth approval process.

item.title: DAO Resolution - TACO Foundation Supervisor Changes (sky)
item.description: A DAO resolution would direct the directors of TACO Foundation to appoint Fortification Foundation as its supervisor, replacing the existing one.

item.title: Risk Stewards: Supply and Borrow Cap Changes on Aave V3 / 2026.11.17 (aave)
item.description: LlamaRisk recommends changing supply and borrow caps on Aave V3 Mantle, Monad, BNB and Core, mostly reductions, with increases for mUSD on Monad and BTCB on BNB.

item.title: [RFC] NSEC Proofs as a Permissionless Release Trigger for TLDs (ens)
item.description: An RFC proposes letting anyone return a claimed TLD to DAO custody by submitting a DNSSEC NSEC proof that its delegation has been removed from the DNS root.

item.title: [Risk Stewards] November 2026 - Stablecoin Interest Rate Adjustments (aave)
item.description: TokenLogic proposes interest-rate changes on 17 stablecoin reserves across Aave V3 and V4: higher Slope 1 on 16, lower on Base EURC, and Base USDC UOptimal from 90% to 92%.

item.title: Technical scope of the DssExecLib v0.1.0 upgrade (sky)
item.description: A forum post scopes the adoption of DssExecLib v0.1.0, the library all Sky Core Spells link against, which is already deployed and audited and moves the compiler from 0.6.x to 0.8.16.

item.title: GIP 152 - Quarterly Investor/DAO Update 1 (gnosis)
item.description: The Gnosis team shares its first quarterly update: the Gnosis App is becoming Circles-first, with an alpha pilot in Kenya and a rebrand to the Circles App planned.

item.title: Protocol Fee Expansion: v4 on Five More Chains (uniswap)
item.description: A Uniswap Snapshot vote on turning on v4 protocol fees on Celo, Soneium, X Layer, World Chain and Zora, and lowering the target fee on two Arbitrum stablecoin pools.

item.title: Upgrade the v4 Protocol Fee Adapter (uniswap)
item.description: A Uniswap Snapshot vote on replacing the v4 fee policy with a flexible per-hook ruleset system on all eight chains, with current fee levels unchanged.

item.title: [Temp Check] Protocol Fee Expansion: v4 on Five More Chains (uniswap)
item.description: A temp check proposes turning on v4 protocol fees on Celo, Soneium, X Layer, World Chain and Zora, and lowering the target fee on two Arbitrum stablecoin pools.

item.title: [Temp Check] Upgrade the v4 Protocol Fee System (uniswap)
item.description: A temp check proposes replacing the v4 fee policy so governance can set protocol fees per hook using reusable rulesets, with current fee levels unchanged.

item.title: Snapshot Governance: Updated Voting Framework (compound)
item.description: The Compound Governance Working Group proposes new eligibility rules for voting and proposing in the comp-vote.eth Snapshot space; onchain governance is unchanged.

item.title: [7.5] [Social] IPS Amendment No. 2: IPS Amendment Authority (ens)
item.description: ENS voters decide whether the ENS Foundation Board, not a DAO vote, may amend the Endowment investment policy, replacing the Meta-Governance Working Group as oversight body.

item.title: LEGO Grant Proposal: NOC Engine, Base L2 wstETH Peg-Defense Routing and Execution Telemetry (lido)
item.description: A team asks for a $10,000 LEGO Pebble Grant to build a wstETH peg-defense routing adapter on Base and a public telemetry dashboard.

item.title: [7.4] [Social] IPS Amendment No. 1: Endowment Options Overlay (ens)
item.description: ENS voters decide whether the Endowment may write covered options as part of its scheduled ETH and stablecoin rebalancing, within written limits.

item.title: Final Proposal (Version 2): Comprehensive Reporting and Audit Standards, Strategic Communications, and Budget Optimization for EGG 2027 (lido)
item.description: A Lido vote would mandate more detailed financial reporting and audits, and ask for 10-15% cuts to Lido Labs 2027 operating budget; early tally is heavily Against.

item.title: Technical scope for the new Test Halo agent setup (sky)
item.description: A technical post describes the onchain setup for a new Sky agent called Test Halo, a dedicated SubProxy and StarGuard, planned for a core spell on 2026-11-19.

item.title: PSM-USDC-A housekeeping (sky)
item.description: A technical post proposes fully offboarding the inactive legacy PSM-USDC-A vault type in Sky, removing its registry entries and permissions, with a core spell planned for 2026-11-19.

item.title: Final Proposal (Version 2): Comprehensive Reporting & Audit Standards, Strategic Communications, and Budget Optimization for EGG 2027 (lido)
item.description: A Lido forum proposal asks Lido Labs and the Finance Workgroup to publish fully itemised financial reports and audits and to build budget cuts into the EGG 2027 plan, instead of paying outside contractors now.

item.title: Technical Scope of the Core L2 Spell on Base assisting Osero's DPAU launch (sky)
item.description: Sidestream describes a Sky Core spell for Base that adds an ERC4626 facet to the Beacon and adjusts the PAS module to support Osero's DPAU launch, planned for the 2026-11-19 Sky Core spell.

item.title: Upgrade VolatilePair hook and update X Layer Releaser (uniswap)
item.description: Snapshot vote on two Uniswap Labs technical updates: capping the VolatilePair hook temporary fee by block gap on Ethereum, and replacing the protocol fee releaser on X Layer so accrued fees can be released and UNI burned.

item.title: What factors should be considered when selecting Security Council members? (optimism)
item.description: A community member proposes ten criteria for choosing Optimism Security Council members, including independence, disclosure and ongoing monitoring, while a separate proposal to change selection is under discussion.
